meta.title: Menuverse | QR Digital Menus for Restaurants
meta.description: Menuverse creates QR digital menus for restaurants, cafes and bars. Upgrade your menu with a QR code, live updates and multilingual support. Try it free!

langTip.body: Select your language from the 🌐 dropdown here.

hero.subtitle: Create stunning, interactive digital menus that captivate your customers and streamline your restaurant operations.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.lead: Powerful tools to create and manage your digital menus with ease

qr.title: QR Code Menus
qr.body: Generate unique QR codes that customers can scan to view your menu instantly on their devices.

live.title: Real-time Updates
live.body: Update prices, items, or availability instantly. Changes reflect immediately across all devices.

templates.title: Beautiful Templates
templates.body: Choose from dozens of professionally designed templates that match your brand identity.

languages.title: Multi-language Support
languages.body: Serve international customers with menus available in multiple languages automatically.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.body: Track which items are most viewed, peak hours, and customer engagement metrics.

dietary.title: Dietary Filters
dietary.body: Let customers filter by dietary preferences - vegan, gluten-free, allergens, and more.

support.title: Have Questions? We're Here to Help!
support.body: Chat directly with our team. We'll help you get started, answer any questions, or guide you through our plans.

1.title: Create Your Account
1.body: Sign up in seconds and access your personalized dashboard.

2.title: Request Your Website
2.body: Share a few details about your preferred style: logo, colors, and overall look. We'll create a custom website tailored to your needs and expectations, ready in no time.

3.title: Build Your Menu
3.body: Add items, upload photos, set prices, and customize your design.

4.title: Share & Engage
4.body: We generate your unique QR codes and deliver them to you, ready to share with your customers instantly.
